The '''Vannan system''' was located in the [[Nijune sector/Legends|Nijune sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the type of [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] known as [[Vannan Crystal]]s.<ref name="IT">{{WEGCite|book=Instant Adventures|story=Heavy Lifting}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Vannan Crystal]]s|system=Vannan [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Vannan [[Star system/Legends|system]] was established in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-4.<ref name="TEA" />
